title: Shopify CEO has Claude build a browser MRI viewer instead of installing Windows software
summary: Tobi Lütke's MRI came on a USB stick that needed Windows-only software; he had Claude read the DICOM files and generate a local HTML viewer to scroll, stack, zoom and annotate his spine scans on his Mac.
agent_role: Claude parsed the DICOM files and wrote the viewer; Lütke prompted for features such as annotation and used the result himself.
outcome: Working browser-based viewer with annotation; Lütke called it "a good example of reflexively reaching for AI"
